mentions.name: Micro
mentions.description: Micro is a personal assistant and home server application, originally started as a Go framework and evolved toward its original mission of being a Google alternative or superapp. It currently ships as a PWA, with an Android app in development.
mentions.source_excerpt: Almost 12 years on Micro https://micro.mu. something I keep trying to kill and won't go away. Started as a Go framework now more of a personal assistant and home server.
mentions.author: asim
